incident-bot: :rotating_light: P0 ALERT — Transit anomaly detected
incident_id=INC-20260315-17877 severity=SEV1
symptom="intermittent packet loss and route churn to eu-west-1, some DNS resolution failures" 
observed=2026-03-15T10:15:00Z
impacted_regions=[eu-west-1]
possible_cause="upstream route leak / AS_PATH anomalies via TransitCo"

Aisha: I'm on it — paging net oncall now. Can someone grab quick impact numbers (errors, top prefixes)?

Mike: ack oncall. quick notes:
- BGP shows duplicate/shorter paths from TransitCo
- AS_PATH looks like: `64496 64500 12345 64501` (unexpected origin)
- Affected prefixes include our /24s for customer-facing edge

Mike: traceroute to a customer IP showing drop at hop 5 (TransitCo)
```
traceroute to 18.205.XX.XX (customer-ip), 30 hops max
 1  10.10.1.1  0.8 ms
 2  100.64.0.5  1.2 ms
 3  198.51.100.23  12.5 ms
 4  203.0.113.45  45.3 ms
 5  transitco-pe-1.example.net  * * *
```

Carlos: seeing correlated DNS resolution errors from eu-west-1 (our resolvers hitting upstream). 5xx spikes in front-door logs. Quick check:
```
http 5xx spikes: 03/15 10:12-10:18 UTC
- 5xx rate +520% vs baseline
- affected customers: ~12
```

Ops-Bot: Runbook: Transit Provider BGP Leak (internal): <https://runbook.internal/transit-bgp-leak>

Aisha: Nate — you're off rotation in 5min, can you take an active hand? I'm in meetings.

Nate: taking it. Oncall handoff :hand:
- opening vendor ticket with TransitCo
- preparing BGP mitigation (filters + prefer BackupNet)

Nate: vendor ticket opened: TransitCo INC# TC-98765 — ETA initial response 15m
VendorNetBot: TransitCo ticket TC-98765 acknowledged. SLA ETA 00:15:00.

Chloe: quick customer impact summary for comms team:
- ~12 EU customers: intermittent errors and elevated latency since 10:12 UTC
- Error type: HTTP 5xx + DNS NXDOMAIN/timeout for lookups through eu resolvers
- Top impacted: payment gateway flows + SSO auth calls
- Support queue: 8 open tickets referencing networking errors

Mike: recommend immediate edge mitigation:
1) Apply ingress prefix filter to drop leaked prefixes from TransitCo
2) Add local-preference/AS-path prepend to prefer BackupNet
3) Announce maintenance (short customer notice)

Mike: config snippets (apply carefully):
```
# drop leaked prefixes from TransitCo (example)
ip prefix-list DROP-TRANSITCO seq 5 deny 203.0.113.0/24
ip prefix-list DROP-TRANSITCO seq 10 permit 0.0.0.0/0 le 32
router bgp 64510
  neighbor 198.51.100.45 filter-list prefix DROP-TRANSITCO in
  neighbor 198.51.100.46 route-map PREFER-BACKUP out
!
route-map PREFER-BACKUP permit 10
  set local-preference 200
  set as-path prepend 64510 64510
```

Carlos: applied prefix-list on edge routers in eu-west-1. `show ip bgp` now: leaked prefix removed from RIB on the affected peers. :thumbsup:

Aisha: nice. Monitor for 10m then we'll reassess. Set dashboard alerts to 30s granularity. :eyes:

Nate: monitoring - initial telemetry:
- latency (payment flow) median: 320ms -> 55ms after filter
- packet loss decreased but not zero, some paths still flapping
- DNS error rate down ~70%

Nate: still waiting on TransitCo root cause. Suggest next step: shift some traffic to BackupNet (warm standby) for high-critical prefixes.

Mike: prepping BGP prepends + community to steer. Will coordinate with infra deploy to avoid session resets.

Chloe: drafting customer notice (short):
"We’re investigating a networking issue affecting customers in EU. Some requests may fail or be slower. We’ve applied mitigations and are working with our upstream provider. We’ll send an update within 30 minutes. — Redwood Inference"

Aisha: send that once we confirm stability for 10m. Also update support playbook with a short note and canned responses.

VendorNetBot: TransitCo update: Root cause identified as misconfiguration at TransitCo edge causing route leak. Working on configuration rollback. ETA 00:20:00.

Carlos: seeing incremental improvements; most prefixes stable.

Nate: initiating controlled traffic shift to BackupNet for top 5 critical customers now (rolling, can rollback).

Ops-Bot: Deployment job started: `netops/shift-traffic-backupnet` (job id 4142). Watch logs: <https://ci.internal/jobs/4142>

Mike: traffic shift in progress — no session resets, metrics trending healthy.

Chloe: support update: sent advisory to affected customers (using draft). Logged support ticket numbers in incident timeline.

Aisha: decision log: mitigation applied = ingress filter + partial traffic shift to BackupNet. Root cause = TransitCo misconfig. Customer impact = intermittent 5xx + latency for ~12 customers, mostly recovered after mitigations.

incident-bot: STATUS UPDATE — INC-20260315-17877
- severity: SEV1 -> Monitoring
- status: mitigations applied, vendor working on permanent fix
- bridge: https://bridge.internal/incidents/INC-20260315-17877

Nate: assigning postmortem owners: Mike (network lead) & Carlos (oncall). Please draft RCA and timeline within 72h.

Aisha: thanks everyone. If we see re-flap or more customer reports, re-open page. Closing active paging window in 30m if stable. :white_check_mark:

Carlos: noting follow-ups: add TransitCo SLAs to vendor review, add automated prefix filtering to runbook, test BackupNet failover plan.

incident-bot: Closing note: incident transitioned to monitoring at 10:45 UTC. Last update by Nate.
